19: /**
20:  * Request ID Middleware for Hono.
21:  *
22:  * @param {object} options - Options for Request ID middleware.
23:  * @param {number} [options.limitLength=255] - The maximum length of request id.
24:  * @param {string} [options.headerName=X-Request-Id] - The header name used in request id.
25:  * @param {generator} [options.generator=() => crypto.randomUUID()] - The request id generation function.
26:  *
27:  * @returns {MiddlewareHandler} The middleware handler function.
28:  *
29:  * @example
30:  * ```ts
31:  * type Variables = RequestIdVariables
32:  * const app = new Hono<{Variables: Variables}>()
33:  *
34:  * app.use(requestId())
35:  * app.get('/', (c) => {
36:  *   console.log(c.get('requestId')) // Debug
37:  *   return c.text('Hello World!')
38:  * })
39:  * ```
40:  */
41: export const requestId = ({
42:   limitLength = 255,
43:   headerName = 'X-Request-Id',
44:   generator = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
45: }: RequestIdOptions = {}): MiddlewareHandler => {
46:   return async function requestId(c, next) {
47:     // If `headerName` is empty string, req.header will return the object
48:     let reqId = headerName ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined
49:     if (!reqId || reqId.length > limitLength || /[^\w\-=]/.test(reqId)) {
50:       reqId = generator(c)
51:     }
52: 
53:     c.set('requestId', reqId)
54:     if (headerName) {
55:       c.header(headerName, reqId)
56:     }
57:     await next()
58:   }
59: }

--- src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts
+++ src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts
@@ -165,4 +165,76 @@
     expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBeNull()
     expect(await res.text()).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
   })
 })
+
+describe('Request ID Middleware with trustIncoming', () => {
+  describe('trustIncoming: true (default)', () => {
+    const app = new Hono()
+    app.use('/default', requestId())
+    app.use('/explicit', requestId({ trustIncoming: true }))
+    app.get('/default', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+    app.get('/explicit', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+    it('Should trust the incoming request id header by default', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/default', {
+        headers: {
+          'X-Request-Id': 'incoming-id',
+        },
+      })
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('incoming-id')
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('incoming-id')
+    })
+
+    it('Should trust the incoming request id header when explicitly true', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/explicit', {
+        headers: {
+          'X-Request-Id': 'incoming-id',
+        },
+      })
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('incoming-id')
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('incoming-id')
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('trustIncoming: false', () => {
+    function generateWord() {
+      return 'GeneratedId'
+    }
+    const app = new Hono()
+    app.use('/requestId', requestId({ trustIncoming: false, generator: generateWord }))
+    app.use('/emptyId', requestId({ trustIncoming: false, generator: generateWord, headerName: '' }))
+    app.get('/requestId', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+    app.get('/emptyId', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+    it('Should ignore the incoming request id header and use the generator', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/requestId', {
+        headers: {
+          'X-Request-Id': 'incoming-id',
+        },
+      })
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('GeneratedId')
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('GeneratedId')
+    })
+
+    it('Should use the generator when no incoming header is present', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/requestId')
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('GeneratedId')
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('GeneratedId')
+    })
+
+    it('Should still expose the generated value with an empty header name', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/emptyId', {
+        headers: {
+          'X-Request-Id': 'incoming-id',
+        },
+      })
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBeNull()
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('GeneratedId')
+    })
+  })
+})

part.text:
Implemented. Here's a summary:

## Changes

### `src/middleware/request-id/request-id.ts`
- Added `trustIncoming?: boolean` to `RequestIdOptions` with `@default true`, documented it, and defaulted it via destructuring (`request-id.ts:17`, `:55`).
- Updated header selection to only read the incoming header when `trustIncoming` is enabled: `headerName && trustIncoming ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined` (`request-id.ts:60`).
- When `false`, the middleware falls through to `generator(c)`, then still runs `c.set('requestId', reqId)` and sets the response header (`request-id.ts:64-67`), so both output channels keep working.

### `src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts`
Added two descriptor blocks:
- `trustIncoming: true` (default and explicit): asserts an incoming `X-Request-Id` is preserved in the response header and `c.get('requestId')`.
- `trustIncoming: false`: asserts an incoming header is ignored, the generator value is used in both the response header and `c.get('requestId')`, works with no incoming header, and still exposes the generated value when `headerName` is `''` (no response header, but context value set).

## Verification
```

      Tests  16 passed (16)
```
Also passed `tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit` (exit 0) and `vp fmt --check` on both changed files.

Changes are left unstaged for review.
